## Expression on this line

The Environmental line at amber Stage 9 is **environmental-regulation-as-instrument-of-the-
sacred-group-order**. Industrial-modern environmental-protection has consolidated: codified-
environmental-statute, a regulatory-and-permitting apparatus, environmental-impact-assessment
process, public-works-of-sanitation, conservation-and-reserve agencies, eco-tax-and-subsidy
statute. There is a functioning regime, a *real* professional-discipline in the modern-econ
discipline-of-environmental-econ-or-climate-science. What has not yet emerged is the operating
principle that environmental-protection is a public-domain subordinated to a rights-equal-
procedure regime vis-à-vis the in-group's industrial-destiny. (This is the orange breakthrough
at Stage 11+. At the moment of Stage 9, environmental-policy is *the instrument-of-the-in-
group-and-the-steward-of-the-in-group's industrial-destiny* rather than a discipline of the
public-domain and the world's standing.)

The constitutive choice is to organize the environmental-domain around the in-group's
sacred order: how much environmental-protection is *granted* is decided within the regulatory-
permitting framework as a *trade* with the in-group's industrial-and-national-strength
interests, not as a discipline of universal-standing-and-ecological-domain. The modern
regulatory-permitting apparatus operates in form; but the *operative logic* keeps the in-
group's destiny as the orientation point.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion — what a higher CoG must keep from amber-9)

- **UL:** the practitioner's professional craftsmanship in environmental-discipline and
  regulation; the craftsman-regulator's dignity.
- **UR:** real standing regulatory-and-permitting infrastructure: codified environmental
  statute; EIA process; conservation-and-reserve agencies; eco-tax-and-subsidy statute;
  professional cadre.
- **LL:** shared-cultural-and-statutory environmentals as the *ways-of-taking-care* of the
  in-group's life-world.
- **LR:** statutory-sanitation-of-environmental-statute, environmental-statutory-framework,
  statutory-regulator, regulator-discipline-of-permits, EIA-statutory-process.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction (clinging to amber-9):** **environmental-as-sacred-trade-with-industrial-
  destiny** — environmental-regulation organized-energy of the regulator around the in-group's
  sacred-industrial-destiny; out-group ecological-concern de-legitimized-as-anti-national-
  growth; the regulator becomes a steward-of-the-steward-of-industrial-strength rather than a
  steward-of-the-public-domain.
- **Dark allergy (amber-9 foundation skipped/fragile):** modern-environmental-statute without
  modern-industrial-discipline-of-statute-discipline; eco-act-without-effective-statute-discipline;
  modern-econ-or-climate-science without institutional-discipline-to-emit-protection-discipline.
- **Golden addiction (grasping Orange prematurely):** **environmental-rights-statistical theater**
  — performative-statutory-environmental-rights-statistical (e.g. climate-imperative, generation-
  liability) while operative-protection-discipline continues to follow in-group industrial
  destination; orange-form, amber-practical-duty-of-destiny.
- **Golden allergy (Jonah / refusing the Orange emergence):** "we are a people, our-environment
  is our-priority; outsider-influence is not-going-to-rewrite-our trajectory." Refusing the
  worldcentric turn that environmental-protection-as-public-domain discipline requires.

## Diagnostic cues (universal signal-types)

Falsifiable signal *types* that place an environmental-system holon at **amber Stage 9**.

- **Permit-decisions correlate with in-group-industrial-destiny.** Patterns of permit-and-
  exemptions-and-prosecution-and-enforcement decisions tracking in-group-industrial-destiny
  rather than evidence-based-statutory ecological-discipline.
- **EIA short-cut and back-room decisions.** Statutory-EIA-process heavily processed by
  statutory-allowances routes-of-issuance, with substantive-EIA-content-curtailed, except
  occasionally in signaled-cases-of-internal-press.
- **Eco-disparity across in-group-out-group geographics.** Statistical eco-statutory-discipline
  applied-by-geography with in-group-geographic-zone receiving better ecological-protection
  than out-group geographic zone — i.e. *statistical-in-equity of eco-protection*.
- **Conservation-area effective-discipline-statistical.** Conservation-and-reserve agencies
  operate on periodic-in-form-effective-discipline-statistical discipline with operational
  fits-and-statutory-starts.
- **Public-procurement eco-disparity statistical.** Public-procurement-discipline for eco-
  beneficiary procurement tracked with non-in-group-statutory-affiliation statistical patterns.
- **Cross-jurisdiction environmental-cohort non-signatory.** Cross-jurisdiction environmental-
  cooperation-regimes non-signatory (e.g. climate-cooperation international agreement
  withholdings, government external environmental-cooperation regime withholdings), except
  where in-group industrial-destiny aligns with operation.
- **Statutory-ecological-discipline intermittent.** Statutory-ecological-discipline operates-
  intermittent-and-statutory-amend-pattern with discretionary-amendments-statistical,
  visible-in-audit.
